Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: single top-down RTS death animation sprite, frame 1 of 4, preview only.
Input image 1: approved Commando/Boone identity, armor, scale, palette, weapon and strict back-view reference. Produce the same character in the first slight hit-stagger pose, NOT a redesign.
Pose: still upright, whole body facing NORTH (top of image), slight lean toward screen right with a small rightward hip tilt and asymmetrically bent knees, one foot slightly drawn inward. Both arms still hold exactly the same single long rifle north above the helmet. Helmet, chest/back, feet and rifle remain generally north. We see back of helmet and broad dark BACK armor plate with gold chevrons, not a face or front chest.
Preserve broad heavy weathered bright pale AQUA shoulder armor, aqua helmet stripe and forearm plates, gold chevrons, dark neutral back armor, gray/tan belt pouches, olive trousers, black boots, rifle design and visible hands. Keep full-body proportions and shoulder/head physical scale near reference. Crisp readable chunky silhouette suitable for 32px on-screen.
Centered complete figure with generous margin. Same overhead camera, lighting and weathered painted realistic sprite style. No blood, no gore, no extra weapon, no text, no watermark, no ground shadow.
Background genuinely transparent alpha if possible. If transparency cannot be provided, use ONLY flat pure WHITE #ffffff background, including gaps between limbs. Never black, gray, checkerboard, gradient, shadow or texture background. Every part of dark clothes/boots must be fully opaque.
